name: Orb of the Reckoner
summary: A crystal orb that lets you glimpse a short way into the future.
description: Fortune-tellers keep it under a cloth. Whatever it shows is true, and the rest is left to the reader.

stats.effect: The orb has 3 charges. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to cast *Augury* from it. The orb regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
